entry_requirements: Verify exact immutable source files and source version, public release and license metadata.
Resolve producer documented participant linkage semantics, record unit, wave code mapping and assignment codes. A header-only participant_id claim does not establish pseudonymity.
Resolve source-defined category and medication labels/codes from producer documentation or explicit workbook labels. Numeric codes cannot be assigned by expected paper counts or familiar assumptions.
If any direct identifier or unanticipated contact field appears, stop record analysis and report only field presence. Never print raw values or participant identifiers.
Root commits the protocol and metadata receipts in the next intake branch before quantitative values are inspected.
excluded_fields: No household, religion, occupation, free-text others fields, questionnaire responses, personal contact reconstruction or participant-level exports. Only the approved linkage, assignment, wave, clinical measurement and history subset enters the finite gate.
phase1_representation_checks: Exact expected headers at frozen locators. Accept only explicitly authorized representation types; formulas, macros, external links and author scripts are never executed.
Opaque linkage keys processed only in memory; never emit keys, rows, per-person assays or derived participant paths. Report aggregate counts or failure categories without identifiers.
Determine whether primary is unique wide person rows, repeated wide rows, or an unresolved representation. Do not collapse duplicate participant rows without documented record semantics.
Determine whether secondary is unique person-wave rows. Validate shared participant-wave sets and matching approved measurements against primary after documented wave mapping.

Validate assigned cluster/regimen consistency across waves; missing follow-up assignment does not erase baseline assignment. Any nonmissing assignment drift is a source check failure, not automatically repaired.
Preserve null, absent, spreadsheet error, string missing-marker, documented invalid and unverified-code states distinctly. No default zero, float coercion or silent complete-case deletion.
phase2_observed_joint_coverage_if_phase1: Report all enrolled released source participants separately from participants with any clinical measurement, complete paired panels and known recorded diabetes event status.
Count joint paths of documented source labels over nominal baseline/12/24 assessments within assigned arm and cluster. Categories retain their producer meanings; no automatic H/P/D engine mapping.
Compare incidence and valid clinical endpoint denominators with paper values without rescaling or selecting rows to force agreement. All discrepancies stay visible.

Count missing two-hour tests stratified by preceding recorded diagnosis history and FPG presence, where history is documented; distinguish compatible protocol-driven absence from unknown test absence.
Retain medication/history observations without inventing start dates, treatment-free duration, remission or biological onset.
Repeated participant summaries preserve shared paths and cluster assignment, never independent binomial sampling.

rules: Published death counts by assigned arm are cumulative at12 and24 months; repeating identical counts is not additional deaths.
No person/cluster/start-state allocation of deaths or loss reasons is claimed. No exact death time is supplied.
Death/loss category allocation must be an explicit compatible integer constraint with bounds; it is not a random independent censoring process.
Any observed follow-up record is not blanket proof of survival to the complete horizon. Absence of a death header is not zero deaths.
If paper and released cohort identity or denominators cannot be established, aggregate death/loss constraints cannot be transferred to raw paths. Keep them parallel facts until reconciled.

conditional_estimand: Source-specific distribution of the recorded linked glycemic-label histories at nominal trial visits, under assigned categorical peer-support package versus booklet, conditional on verified released-source inclusion and separately described measurement availability. No true clinical transition probability or causal dietary dose is inferred.
unresolved_before_any_fit: producer code dictionary and clinical-label semantics
death/loss linkage or justified partial-identification constraints
scientific review and independent evaluation target
allowed_outputs: unresolved-code and failed-check counts without participant values
reproducible authored receipt and source-specific admission decision
aggregate observed joint-label path table only after documented semantics and cohort identity pass
prohibited_outputs: causal isolated food or UPF dose response
stop_conditions: direct identifiers or contact fields detected
parent has not frozen the next intake branch
